mapper.select: SELECT id, issue_id, meeting_id, room_id, reporter_role, assignee_role, reason, required_fix, due_at, status, resolved_at, create_time FROM ai_meeting_issue WHERE meeting_id = #{meetingId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC, id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_meeting_issue SET status = 'RESOLVED', resolved_at = #{resolvedAt}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE meeting_id = #{meetingId} AND assignee_role = #{assigneeRole} AND status = 'OPEN' AND is_deleted = 0
